name: Yuki* to Ri* wa Shujinkou no Koto ga Suki Datta no ni Kimodebu no Chi*po Benki ni Narimashita.
original_name: 雪●とり●は主人公の事が好きだったのにキモデブのチ●ポ便器になりました。
source:
Two heroines from Pers*na may have loved the protagonist,
but in The C*ck Objectificiation of Yuk*ko and R*se they each
succumb to the wishes of a kimo-debu.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE106930.html]Dlsite English[/url]]
translation:
《女神○闻录》中的两位女主角或许爱过主人公，可在《雪○与理○成了恶心胖子的玩物》中，她们最终都屈从于一个令人厌恶的胖子的欲望。
